blocks.text: Draft for Jared's approval. Built only from the monthly MLS® figures (SnapStats) for Riverwood. It has no local notes, street boundaries, schools or listing feed yet; see the open items below.

Riverwood, Port Coquitlam: 10 houses and 21 condos and townhomes listed at the end of September, with 2 and 8 sold in the month. It is one of 10 communities the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures break out for Port Coquitlam.
Riverwood homes listed and sold, June to September 2026

Riverwood, September 2026. Detached houses: 10 listed at month end and 2 sold in September, a sales ratio of 20% (a balanced market). Condos and townhomes: 21 listed at month end and 8 sold in September, a sales ratio of 38% (a sellers’ market).

blocks.text: Between June 2026 and September 2026, detached houses: listings rose from 7 in June to 10 in September (+42.9%), and it took 4.2% of the city’s 72 sales over the period; condos and townhomes: listings fell from 29 in June to 21 in September (−27.6%), and it took 21.2% of the city’s 151 sales over the period.
The monthly write-ups singled out Riverwood for condos and townhomes in June, July, August, September (a sellers’ best bet).
Riverwood share of Port Coquitlam listings and sales by month

In Riverwood, its share of the houses listed in Port Coquitlam went from 4.1% in June to 6.5% in September and its share of the condos and townhomes listed went from 12.6% to 9.4%. A share that holds steady while the city moves means the community is following the city; a share that drifts means it is moving differently.

blocks.text: Riverwood home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

66 townhomes sold in Riverwood with a median price of $881,750 (the middle half sold between $816,250 and $975,000), taking a median of 22 days to sell at 97.4% of the last list price; 8% sold above list. They had a median $581 per square foot, a median year built of 2005 and a median strata fee of $395 a month. 15 houses sold in Riverwood with a median price of $1,410,000 (the middle half sold between $1,330,000 and $1,510,000), taking a median of 25 days to sell at 97.0% of the last list price; 13% sold above list. They had a median $629 per square foot, a median year built of 1997 and a median lot of 4,617 square feet.

blocks.text: Lots and land in Riverwood
Fee-simple lots

items.t: Character, as the research states it: single-detached homes under RS1, RS2, RS3 and RS4 zones in Zoning Bylaw No. 3630, in an established neighbourhood per the OCP, with a strong built townhome component. A verified age and style breakdown is UNVERIFIED.

Lot sizes, as the bylaw states them: RS zone minimum lot widths run from at least 9.5 m (RS4) to at least 30 m (RS3) — RS1 at least 15 m, RS2 at least 12 m. Typical Riverwood lot dimensions beyond those bylaw minimums are UNVERIFIED — no typical-size table is invented here.
Tenure: detached homes are freehold; townhomes are strata titled. No fee-simple townhouse complex was verified in Riverwood — the fee-simple stock is detached houses.

Serviced position: city stock is on municipal water and sewer, billed as flat annual water and sewer fees, billed separately and due March 31, 2026 on the research record. A per-lot servicing figure for a new subdivision: UNVERIFIED.
ALR vs non-ALR: no ALR land was confirmed inside Riverwood in the research — the ground is urban north-east PoCo. ALR status remains a per-parcel check on ALC mapping, and no ALR split is stated.

blocks.text: Streets, schools and getting around Riverwood

items.t: Riverwood is an established residential neighbourhood on the north-east side of the City of Port Coquitlam, around Riverwood Gate and Coast Meridian Road by the Pitt River; Terry Fox Secondary School is at 1260 Riverwood Gate. "Riverwood" is also the board (GVR) sub-area name in the SnapStats GVR September 2026 report, and the City's Official Community Plan (Bylaw No. 3838) names Riverwood and Citadel Heights as established residential neighbourhoods. Boundary roads are UNVERIFIED — no City neighbourhood map states them.
Nearby areas: Citadel PQ to the west, Mary Hill to the south, the Dominion Avenue and Fremont growth areas further east, and Pitt Meadows across the Pitt River.

Roads and transit: Coast Meridian Road and Riverwood Gate serve the area, connecting south to Lougheed Highway and the Pitt River Bridge corridor toward Pitt Meadows and Maple Ridge. TransLink buses connect to Port Coquitlam Station (West Coast Express) and Coquitlam Central Station (Millennium Line); specific route numbers through Riverwood are UNVERIFIED. Driving commute times: UNVERIFIED.

Parks, recreation and health: the Traboulay PoCo Trail passes the Pitt River side of the city near Riverwood, and City parks in the wider north-east include Fortress Park at 2698 Fortress Court; Hyde Creek Recreation Centre at 1379 Laurier Avenue serves the north side, and the Terry Fox Library is at the Port Coquitlam Community Centre, 2150 Wilson Avenue. The nearest hospital is Eagle Ridge Hospital, 475 Guildford Way, Port Moody (Fraser Health). Shopping locations serving the sub-area on official sources: UNVERIFIED.

Flood position: land toward the Pitt River is low-lying, and a significant portion of the city is within the Fraser and Pitt River floodplain behind dykes; lot-level flood status for Riverwood is UNVERIFIED — confirm the specific lot with the City before writing.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect land buyers in Riverwood

items.t: City plan: Port Coquitlam's Official Community Plan is Bylaw No. 3838, which names Riverwood and Citadel Heights as established residential neighbourhoods; no Riverwood-specific major project was confirmed in the research pass.

Zoning and SSMUH, as the City states it: Zoning Bylaw No. 3630 (2008) governs — single-detached homes under RS1–RS4 (minimum lot widths at least 15 m RS1, 12 m RS2, 30 m RS3, 9.5 m RS4), townhouse zones RTh1, RTh2 and RTh3 in the bylaw.

ALR rules (for completeness — no Riverwood ALR parcel is confirmed here): subdivision within the ALR requires ALC approval; ALR residences cannot be stratified (ALC Bulletin 09 s. 6; SPA s. 239; ALCA s. 21(1)); ALC residence caps: principal ≤500 m², suite within principal only, additional residence 90 m² (≤40 ha) / 186 m² (>40 ha).

Port Coquitlam property taxes and utilities: property taxes for 2026 were due July 2, 2026, with a 5% penalty on current taxes unpaid after July 2, 2026 and a further 5% after September 15, 2026; the City's 2026 increase was 1.95% for the average home, and the City states it has the lowest average property taxes and utility fees in Metro Vancouver; utility bills are flat annual water and sewer fees, billed separately and due March 31, 2026.

blocks.text: Good to know about Riverwood

items.t: The same developer sells and rents on the same street. Mosaic built Fremont Green (550 Seaborne Place, strata, 2014), the rental building next door at 553 Seaborne Place, and Dominion's rowhomes/townhouses at Avon Place in the same Fremont pocket — a buyer comparing "Fremont" or "Dominion" addresses has to establish which tenure each address is before comparing anything.
Dominion cannot agree on its own birth year.
A plan number that only one kind of source carries is not a verified plan number.

Riverwood's attached market is its fast lane, but none of it is land. The sub-area's 38% attached sales ratio in September 2026 was the strongest of any Port Coquitlam sub-area that month — in general-market townhome complexes, on built strata lots.
Terry Fox Secondary is named for the city's own.

faq.q: How many homes are for sale in Riverwood?
faq.a: At the end of September 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 10 houses and 21 condos and townhomes listed in Riverwood. Those are month-end counts and they move daily, so ask Jared for a current list.

faq.q: Is Riverwood a buyers’ or sellers’ market?
faq.a: In September 2026, houses had a sales ratio of 20% (a balanced market); condos and townhomes had 38% (a sellers’ market). The sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed; on the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers. One month in one community is a small sample, so look at the monthly table above before you decide.

faq.q: How many homes sold in Riverwood from June to September 2026?
faq.a: 3 houses and 32 condos and townhomes sold in Riverwood over those 4 months; detached houses peaked in September with 2 sold and condos and townhomes peaked in June with 10 sold.

faq.q: How big is Riverwood compared with the rest of Port Coquitlam?
faq.a: In September 2026, Riverwood held 6.5% of the 153 detached houses listed in Port Coquitlam and 9.4% of the 224 condos and townhomes listed in Port Coquitlam.

faq.q: What mix of houses and condos is for sale in Riverwood?
faq.a: In September 2026, houses made up 32.3% of the 31 homes listed in Riverwood and condos and townhomes made up 67.7%; of the 10 that sold, houses were 20.0% and condos and townhomes 80.0%.

faq.q: Are there more or fewer homes for sale in Riverwood than in June?
faq.a: Listings of detached houses rose from 7 in June to 10 in September 2026 (+42.9%); condos and townhomes fell from 29 in June to 21 in September 2026 (−27.6%).

faq.q: What did townhomes in Riverwood sell for?
faq.a: 66 townhomes sold in Riverwood between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $881,750.

faq.q: How long do townhomes take to sell in Riverwood?
faq.a: The median was 22 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 97.4% of the last list price (8% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: Is Riverwood in Surrey or Port Coquitlam?
faq.a: 3838), by the Pitt River. Surrey bylaws and Surrey figures do not apply here, whatever an older brief or search snippet says.

faq.q: Can I buy a vacant lot in Riverwood?
faq.a: No vacant-lot offering is verified — no named bare-land subdivision, no bare-land strata offered as lots, and presale lot offerings verified: zero.

faq.q: What extra units can an RS lot hold?
faq.a: 3 to 6 small-scale multi-unit housing units without rezoning, depending on lot size, location and transit proximity, as the City states it — plus the RS zone minimum lot widths (9.5 m in RS4 up to 30 m in RS3) frame any split discussion.

Land toward the Pitt River is low-lying and much of the city is floodplain behind dykes; lot-level status is UNVERIFIED — check the specific lot with the City before writing, and do not import any other city's floodplain percentage.

faq.q: Which schools serve a Riverwood lot?
faq.a: Address-based in SD43 — the settled sample run (1260 Riverwood Gate → Blakeburn Elementary, Minnekhada Middle, Terry Fox Secondary) does not transfer to other addresses, though Terry Fox Secondary itself stands in the neighbourhood. Run the locator for the exact lot.
